title: Torrust Agent Reply V1
description: One reply of an agent, as stored in its reply file.

schema-version.description: The version of the reply format: always 1.

agent.description: The agent that wrote the reply.

model.description: The model the agent ran on, as the harness names it, such as `claude-opus-5-5`.

subject.description: What the reply is about: a task (`t2`) or a pull request (`pr2920`).

round.description: The round of this agent on this subject.

created-utc.description: When the reply was written, in UTC: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`.

verdict.description: The outcome, from which the orchestrator decides the next step.

summary.description: A short account of what the agent did or found.

findings.description: The problems found; empty when there are none.

questions.description: The questions for the contributor; empty when there are none.

evidence.description: The commands run and what they printed, or other facts the reply rests on.

SchemaVersion.description: The version of the reply format.

Agent.description: An agent that writes reply files.

Text.description: A text that is not blank.

Subject.description: A task of the Implementation Plan (`t2`) or a pull request (`pr2920`).

Round.description: The round of the agent on the subject.

Verdict.description: The outcome of a reply. The list is closed: the orchestrator reads only this field.

oneOf.description: A review found nothing that blocks the work.
A review found something that must change.
The agent finished the work it was given.
The agent cannot go on without something it does not have.
The agent needs an answer from the contributor.

Finding.description: One problem found by the agent.

location.description: Where it is, such as `src/name.rs:42` or a section of a document.

Severity.description: The severity of a finding, with the same names as the pull-request review audits.
